Definition: from G1537 and G5258; awake:--X out of sleep.
BiblicalUsage: The word éxypnos carries the sense of X out of sleep. In Acts 16:27, the text says "And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep."
TheologicalSignificance: In éxypnos I find no hidden theology; it simply means X out of sleep.
RelatedEvents: Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
